en.quote: …under no circumstances do I intend to change the Constitution.
en.head: Putin signed constitutional amendments in 2020.
en.body: As president, Putin signed a constitutional amendment law on March 14, 2020. After the nationwide vote, he signed a decree publishing the revised Constitution; the changes took effect on July 4. One provision allowed him to seek office again without counting his earlier presidential terms. This directly tests his stated personal intention not to change the Constitution.

osrc.t: Putin’s decree publishing the amended Constitution
